categories.main_business_segments: Medlive Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily as an online professional physician platform in China, offering three main solution categories: precision marketing and corporate solutions, medical knowledge solutions, and intelligent patient management solutions. The majority of revenue is derived from precision marketing services provided to pharmaceutical and medical device companies. The company also offers corporate solutions for market research and clinical trial efficiency, medical knowledge solutions for continuing education and clinical decision support, and patient management services including online diagnosis and education.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI technologies including a self-developed medical vertical domain large AI model based on Transformer architecture, integrating natural language processing (NLP), computer vision (CV), retrieval augmented generation (RAG), and multimodal technologies. These AI tools power products such as AI Q&A systems, AI diagnosis and treatment maps, AI rational medication systems, and AI-assisted writing tools. The platform also uses AI-driven physician portrait engines and intelligent recommendation systems to optimize content delivery and marketing precision.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Medlive primarily serves pharmaceutical and medical device companies, hospitals, and healthcare professionals including licensed physicians in China. The platform supports over 7 million registered physicians, covering 88% of licensed physicians in China. The company also collaborates with non-profit organizations for patient education and management. Its solutions address the needs of clinical research, academic education, digital marketing, and patient management within the healthcare industry.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Mainland China, which accounts for the vast majority of its revenue. It also has some overseas operations and participates in international academic conferences, providing multilingual support including simultaneous interpretation in over 10 languages. The headquarters and principal operations are based in Beijing, with additional offices in Hong Kong and subsidiaries across China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Medlive operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the healthcare supply chain, focusing on digital platforms that empower physicians and pharmaceutical/medical device companies. It provides digital marketing, clinical research support, medical knowledge dissemination, and patient management services, acting as a technology and service provider bridging pharmaceutical companies, healthcare professionals, and patients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on deepening AI integration across medical scenarios, expanding specialized services horizontally by disease and specialty, and extending vertically across the full lifecycle of pharmaceutical and medical device products. It emphasizes innovation in AI large models, generative AI applications, big data analytics, and intelligent patient management. The company also prioritizes talent development through a national postdoctoral research workstation and industry-university-research collaborations to accelerate AI healthcare applications.
categories.revenue_model: Medlive generates revenue mainly through fees charged to pharmaceutical and medical device companies for digital marketing, academic education, and corporate solutions including market research and clinical trial support. It also earns fees from non-profit organizations and pharmaceutical companies for patient education and management services, as well as commissions from online consultation and prescription services on its Internet hospital platform. Revenue is linked to user engagement metrics such as paid clicks on digital content.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Medlive is positioned as the leading online professional physician platform in China, with a high market penetration covering 88% of licensed physicians. It maintains a competitive edge through proprietary AI technologies, comprehensive service offerings, and strategic partnerships with authoritative medical associations. The company’s strong user base and integrated ecosystem create significant barriers to entry, although it operates in a competitive digital healthcare and medical information technology industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 December 2024, Medlive reported revenue of approximately RMB558.5 million, representing a 35.5% increase from the previous year. Net profit was RMB330.3 million, up 31.2%, with a net profit margin of 59.1%. The company’s adjusted net profit was RMB323.6 million, a 19.4% increase year-over-year. It has substantial cash reserves and investments, no borrowings, and continues to invest in R&D and strategic acquisitions, reflecting a strong growth trajectory and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Medlive’s value proposition lies in its technology-driven, AI-empowered platform that integrates professional medical content, intelligent tools, and a large physician user base to enhance clinical decision-making, academic research, and digital marketing efficiency. Its proprietary AI models and comprehensive ecosystem enable precise targeting and engagement of physicians, improved patient management, and accelerated medical knowledge dissemination. The company emphasizes compliance, accuracy, and innovation to differentiate itself in the digital healthcare market.
